ValidationRule.description: An RFP Closed Reason must be selected when a Capture Strategy moves to the RFP Closed stage. Applies to records created on or after 2026-08-31; users with the Bypass CapStrat Validation permission are exempt.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($Permission.Bypass_CapStrat_Validation) && OR(ISNEW(), CreatedDate >= DATETIMEVALUE("2026-08-31 00:00:00")) && ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "RFP Closed") && ISBLANK(TEXT(RFP_Closed__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select an RFP Closed Reason when moving this Capture Strategy to RFP Closed.
